expectationsBeforeClassifierEdit: Biodiesel B100, ethanol, renewable diesel/other biofuels exclude other biofuel components. Neither output, sales, stock nor capacity of one fuel becomes whole biofuels.
Biodiesel plant counts are producer counts, not customers or capacity. Stock change is not ending stocks. Sales of B100 in blends and neat B100 remain separate; no invented sum.
Biofuel production feedstocks such as corn, fats and oils are manufacturing inputs, not finished-biofuel production or consumption. Feedstock process naming cannot override full source definitions.
Gas-plant natural gas liquids are petroleum components, not gaseous natural-gas production. LPG and individual liquid fractions remain components.
Oxygenates other than ethanol are petroleum/blending components, not automatically renewable biofuels. Captive and merchant plant populations remain separate.

Fuel used at refineries or biofuel plants is consumption by a component of industry; not whole industrial consumption. Natural gas used as hydrogen feedstock is consumption of gas, not gas or hydrogen production.
Purchased electricity excludes on-site output; purchased steam and hydrogen have no product in the fixed vocabulary. Mixed other fuels including renewables is not wholly renewable.

Original source units are preserved. Capacity Million Gallons has annual production potential per source, not an observed production total. Counts may have no parenthetic unit; count meaning comes from the source process.
Native product NA is a structural placeholder; resolve fuel from reviewed process and full series. Unknown/contradictory definitions stay pending.
Historical biodiesel report ends December 2020; successor report is distinct. A metadata definition does not establish current availability.

findings.finding: Feedstocks include corn, oils and fats used to make biofuels; these are not finished fuels. Some renewable feedstocks are co-processed with petroleum.
Production capacity is maximum possible production; separate ethanol, biodiesel and other biofuel capacities are components.
Biofuel plant consumption includes purchased electricity and steam, natural gas, coal and biogas; purchased electricity excludes plant self-generation.
Natural gas plants recover liquid fractions; NGPL production is not gaseous natural-gas production.
Oxygenate production contains ethanol and non-biofuel blending chemicals; captive and merchant facility populations differ.
Natural gas feedstock for hydrogen is a refinery gas use, not production of gas.
Refinery fuel consumption is fuel used in operating refineries, not total industrial consumption.
Biodiesel report is discontinued after December 2020 and retained for history; capacities are million gallons per year. Later biofuel report is the successor.

scopeCasesForCheckpoint.decision: Feedstocks are not finished fuel; count/stock-change/input measurements cannot fill output/customer/storage levels.
Biodiesel/ethanol/LPG components and refinery/biofuel-plant fuel use stay narrower. Headline rule does not turn one fuel or industry subsector into the whole requested product/sector.
